article.title: Driving regulations.
article.content: The Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, make regulations for the driving of motor vehicles.
article.html:
118Driving regulations.

Section 118 · Chapter VIII · page 78 of the Act

The Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, make regulations for the driving of motor vehicles.
